create_rendered_mesh_dataset: create a RenderedMeshDatasetMapProvider to generate synthetic training renders of a 3D mesh from multiple viewpoints
generate_cow_renders: generate synthetic renders and silhouette masks of a mesh from uniformly sampled azimuth camera angles
get_dataset_map: get a DatasetMap with train dataset containing rendered images, masks, and camera poses from a mesh
get_all_train_cameras: get all FoVPerspectiveCameras poses used for training renders from a RenderedMeshDatasetMapProvider
review_rendered_mesh_provider: review the RenderedMeshDatasetMapProvider class to understand mesh rendering pipeline with Phong shading and rasterization
